title: UAE E-Invoicing Fines: AED 5,000 a Month (Avoid Them in Zoho Books) #Shorts
description:
UAE e-invoicing penalties (Cabinet Decision No. 106 of 2025): missing the deadline to appoint an accredited service provider (ASP) costs AED 5,000 per month or part of a month - even one day late counts as a full month. Late or missing e-invoices and credit notes cost AED 100 each, capped at AED 5,000 per month.

Deadlines: revenue AED 50M or more - mandatory from 1 January 2027; below AED 50M - ASP by 31 March 2027, mandatory from 1 July 2027.

1. Zoho Books > Settings > Taxes & Compliance > E-Invoicing > Setup Now.
2. Appoint Zoho Software Trading LLC (Ministry of Finance accredited ASP) in EmaraTax.
3. Click Verify & Complete Setup, then send invoices through Peppol from Zoho Books.

Not tax or legal advice - confirm with your tax advisor and mof.gov.ae/einvoicing.

story.title: UAE e-invoicing: Deadlines, penalties, and how to prepare (Zoho TechBizz, 28 Oct 2026)
story.summary: Revenue AED 50M or more: appoint an ASP by 30 October 2026, e-invoicing mandatory from 1 January 2027. Revenue below AED 50M: ASP by 31 March 2027, mandatory from 1 July 2027. Government entities: ASP by 31 March 2027, mandatory from 1 October 2027. Penalties (Cabinet Decision No. 106 of 2025): missing the ASP deadline AED 5,000 per month or part of a month (one day late counts as a full month); late or missing e-invoices and credit notes AED 100 each, capped at AED 5,000 per month. Zoho Software Trading LLC is a Ministry of Finance accredited eInvoicing service provider (ASP); Zoho Books Professional and higher plans in the UAE include the first 100 e-invoicing transactions free. Collect each buyer's TRN, Peppol ID, address and VAT treatment. Zoho Books setup: Settings > Taxes & Compliance > E-Invoicing > Setup Now, verify Registered Business Name, TIN, TRN, address; appoint Zoho Software Trading LLC in EmaraTax; back in Zoho Books tick that EmaraTax and ASP setup is done and click Verify & Complete Setup.
story.source: Zoho TechBizz + Zoho Blog + Zoho Books help
